dedupe_keys.name: plum global land use v1 2 scenario land use consumption and yield data f1 f5

description: This Lund University dataset gives global land use from the Parsimonious Land Use Model version 1.2 (PLUM1.2), with auxiliary consumption and yield data, for five future scenarios F1 to F5 described by Engström and others (2016). The DataCite record says the scenarios are based on the shared socio-economic pathways, with scenario-specific yield time series simulated by LPJ-GUESS as input to PLUM, and that it gives the mean yield for each scenario, so the spread across general circulation models is not included. It was published in 2016 by Stefan Olin and Kerstin Engström on the Lund University data portal; the licence, format, resolution and time span are not stated on the pages read (the portal needs JavaScript). Coverage is global. Caveats: these are model projections, and climate model variability is averaged out. For simulation it gives future cropland and pasture patterns and food demand under socio-economic scenarios, to set long-term agricultural exposure and land use change in infrastructure and food system models. Related catalogue records include MAgPIE and GLOBIOM.
